writeup: TIC 447439469 is a candidate eclipsing binary star system with an orbital period of 1.0401 days. The primary eclipse causes a 3.33% dimming in brightness, detected with a signal-to-noise ratio of 333.2 using automated analysis of TESS photometry. A secondary eclipse was not detected. Pixel-level imaging analysis achieved a peak signal-to-noise of 30.3, though the centroid offset of 2.4 arcsec from the target position should be noted. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, suggesting it represents a previously unknown system. The machine-learning screening score of 0.65 indicates moderate confidence that this represents a real astronomical target rather than a false positive.
